test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What happens when plants are kept in dark room for three days?

options.text: Plants oil reserves get used up
Plants starch resources get used up

solution:
The correct answer is __**Plants starch resources get used up**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When plants are kept in a dark room for three days, they undergo significant changes due to the lack of sunlight, which is crucial for their survival and growth. Here's what happens:
 
• Photosynthesis Stops: Plants rely on sunlight to perform photosynthesis, the process of converting light energy into chemical energy (glucose). In the absence of light, photosynthesis ceases. This means the plant can no longer produce its own food.
 
• Starch Depletion: Plants store food in the form of starch. When photosynthesis stops, the plant starts utilizing the stored starch for energy. Over time, the starch reserves get depleted.
 
• Chlorophyll Degradation: Chlorophyll, the green pigment responsible for capturing sunlight, starts to degrade in the absence of light. This leads to a loss of green color in the leaves, which may turn yellow or pale.
 
• Growth Inhibition: Without the energy produced through photosynthesis, the plant cannot synthesize new cells and tissues. This results in stunted growth and development.
 
• Withering and Death: If the plant is kept in the dark for an extended period, it will eventually exhaust its stored energy reserves and die.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other Effects:
 
• The plant may exhibit weakened stems and leaves.
 
• It may become more susceptible to diseases and pests.
 
• Flowering and fruiting may be significantly impacted or cease altogether.
